Discover key players leading the AI and robotics revolution, advancing industries with cutting-edge solutions, and shaping our future through impactful innovation. Check out these leaders today! Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri October 17, 2024 5:39 pm Introduction Top Automation Firms to Keep an Eye on in 2024 and Why The process of automating production facilities with robotics, computers, information technology, and data-driven, intelligent control systems is known as industrial automation, sometimes known as plant automation. The demand for intelligent solutions has made automation companies the backbone of today’s digital evolution. From AI-driven workflows to industrial automation, 2025 is all about rapid innovation. This list highlights top industrial automation companies leading the way—especially in emerging tech cities like Pune. If you’re aspiring to work with a leading automation company, now is the time to upskill. Enroll in our industry-recognized Automation Anywhere Course at 3RI Technologies and tap into the opportunities offered by the best automation companies in Pune and globally. Step into a future where automation drives success. By introducing industrial automation, businesses can reduce production costs, boost productivity, standardize manufacturing processes, and make efficient use of resources. Compared to human labor, industrial automation, also referred to as “smart manufacturing,” produces reliable, error-free results with less human interaction. Industry 4.0, 5G technology, the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), and smart devices, and the growing demand for mass production in large quantities across multiple. Every industry has played a part in the steady rise in the use of industrial automation throughout the world. Discover the Best Automation Companies in Pune and Beyond The practice of employing technology to automate tasks so that humans may do less work is known as automation. By using technology, it manages the distribution of goods and services and automates time-consuming operations. The IT systems, robotics, and automotive industries all use automation. Numerous advantages of automation include increased accuracy, productivity, and economies of scale. Automation training in Pune , for instance, improves efficiency and dependability while decreasing errors in manufacturing and production operations. Automation comes in different forms, each with a distinct application. Examples of these include corporate process, industrial, and home automation. The future of automation is represented by the confluence of AI, ML, and the Internet of Things, which offers ever-more-advanced and intelligent systems. Top Automation Companies in 2024 and Why To help usher in this new era of smart production, some of the leading automation businesses in the world are providing hardware, software, and solutions. The following is a list of the top workplaces for industrial automation in 2024 Schneider Electric Schneider Electric is renowned for its breakthroughs in fusing cutting-edge energy and process technologies to build more profitable and environmentally friendly companies. It supplies equipment comprising medium voltage distribution, building automation, control systems, and grid automation. To increase building productivity, value, and efficiency, Schneider Electric’s EcoStruxureTM Building technology securely connects hardware, software, and services via an Ethernet IP backbone. EcoStruxure Grid can help electric utilities with issues related to grid reliability. Its end-to-end software cycle (from design, build, run, and maintain) is made possible by its digital architecture and services, which also close the gap between supply and demand. This contributes to utilities’ increased sustainability. EcoStruxure IT secures critical information and data. It makes sure that data centers’ physical architecture is adaptable enough to handle demand and growth in the future. It also aids in thwarting cyberattacks. With its headquarters located in Rueil-Malmaison, France, Schneider Electric has 560 office sites spread throughout 117 countries. There are 135,000 workers there. In 2020, it brought in €25.2 billion in revenue and had net profits of €2.1 billion. Yokogawa Electric Japan is home to the global headquarters of Yokogawa Electric Corporation. Information technology, industrial automation, test, control, and measurement are all included in its operations. It is also an electrical engineering and software specialist. A variety of smart control systems are available from Yokogawa Electric Company, including programmable logic controllers (PLCs), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA), and distributed control systems (DCS), for automated tasks that are hassle-free. New developments in the field of industrial automation include: Synaptic business automation, which enables businesses to use cutting-edge information technology to automate factory management and industrial operations, increasing productivity and profitability. PreX – Offers a wide range of automation technologies, services, and solutions to help customers digitalize and transform their organizations in a constantly changing technological environment. CENTUM VP: A control network, human-machine interfaces, and field control stations are all part of this factory automation security architecture. With its headquarters located in Tokyo, Yokogawa Electric Corporation employs 17,715 people. It operates in 61 countries with 118 firms and 84 subsidiaries. ABB One of the best automation firms to work for is ABB, which specializes in offering different kinds of automation solutions. This global corporation is Swedish, with offices in Vasteras, Switzerland, Zurich, and Sweden. It has operations in over 100 nations. It is a frontrunner in automation, robotics, heavy electrical equipment, and power technologies. They provide motors that run machines and processes, robots for a variety of uses, and automation technology for companies. Goods and Services They Provide: Power Grid Engineering Consulting Training and Education Robotics and Drives Gynger Gynger is the first AI-driven payment with integrated financing designed specifically for technology buyers and sellers. This tool assists vendors in offering flexible payment choices and purchasers in financing, managing, and paying for all technology bills. Gynger is especially beneficial for companies who require software but may not have the funds available right now. Software vendors and buyers can both benefit from this arrangement. Goods and Services They Provide: AI-driven payments Finance that is embedded Expand the runway Put money into expansion Are you looking after Career Guidance from Experts? Book Now Want Free Career Counseling? Just fill in your details, and one of our expert will call you ! Email Phone Send Emerson Electric Co. The global technology and engineering company Emerson Electric Co. is based in Ferguson, Missouri, in the United States. It offers customers cutting-edge solutions for commercial, residential, and industrial applications. This automation firm creates sustainable solutions for their customers by fusing cutting-edge technologies with industry-leading experience. Goods and Services They Provide: Automated Systems Solutions for Businesses and Homes Instruments for Analysis VidMob The world’s top provider of intelligent creativity solutions, VidMob meets all of a brand’s creative requirements. It’s an analytical platform that makes use of data to gain a deeper understanding of its customers and boost marketing effectiveness. It collects data about your clients so you can determine the kind of material they enjoy. VidMob makes use of this information to assist you in creating advertisements that draw viewers in and yield a response, therefore enhancing the effectiveness of your marketing initiatives. Goods and Services They Provide: Innovative Automation Reducing media waste Measuring creative quality Walmart Advanced Systems & Robotics Boston, USA is home to Walmart Advanced Systems & Robotics’ corporate office. It is a crucial part of Walmart’s global business operations. This business specializes on creating innovative solutions for Walmart. This company works on supply chain and store operations using automation, robotics, and artificial intelligence. Goods and Services They Provide: Driverless Automobiles AI-driven personal assistants Optimization of the Supply Chain Honeywell Under its primary division, Honeywell Aerospace, Honeywell International Inc. manufactures avionics, aircraft engines, auxiliary power units, and vital aviation equipment. This Fortune 100 company also operates in the following sectors: home and building technologies (HBT), safety and productivity solutions (SPS), performance materials and technologies (PMT), and HBT. With its headquarters in Charlotte, North Carolina, the company has 110,000 employees. With the goal of providing businesses with automated distribution solutions that enhance large-scale material handling operations’ throughput, speed, and accuracy, Honeywell announced the 2019 launch of Honeywell Robotics. One of the best automation firms to watch in 2022 is Honeywell Robotics, which holds an accreditation from the Robotic Industries Association . As machine learning, computer vision, and artificial intelligence become more widely used, Honeywell Robotics will continue to provide innovative, cutting-edge solutions to transform traditional warehouses and distribution facilities into smart infrastructures. Siemens Siemens Siemens is Europe’s largest industrial manufacturing enterprise, operating in over 100 countries. Among the domains of automation, digitization, and electrification, Siemens is a renowned inventor. It is also widely distributed throughout other industrial domains, including energy, manufacturing, infrastructure, and healthcare. Siemens integrates state-of-the-art technologies with its vast automation experience to enable intelligent behavior of production infrastructures, autonomous automation, and cloud-based solutions. These technologies encompass artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and the industrial internet of things (IIoT). Industrial Automation Advancements: SIMATIC PCS 7 V 9.0 – SIMATIC PCS 7 Version 9 increases the agility of industrial process automation and opens the door to digital transformation by utilizing PROFINET-based hardware. SIMATIC PCS Neo: With its device-independent, direct, secure system access, excellent data consistency, and user-friendly use in this digital age, this web-based program offers a plethora of automation opportunities. Siemens, with 293,000 employees as of 2020, €4.2 billion in net income, and €57.138 billion in revenue, is one of the best automation companies to work for in 2021. The corporation’s head office is in Berlin. Mitsubishi Electric Leading producer of electrical and electronic goods worldwide is Mitsubishi Electric, the primary business of the Japanese multinational Mitsubishi Group. With its headquarters located in Tokyo, the corporation employs 145,650 people. The rise of the global automation market is largely attributed to Japan’s extensive range of innovative products, which includes smart automation solutions. One of the top automation companies in the world, Mitsubishi Electric, makes sophisticated industrial robots with force detection and three-dimensional (3D) vision. The robots provide best-in-class accuracy and speed in both difficult and straightforward applications. They may also function in collaborative settings. Among Mitsubishi’s innovations are Robots of the vertical type: Six-axis arms are incorporated into Mitsubishi Electric’s vertical robots, the RV-F, RV-CR, and RV-FR series, to ensure more versatility. Robots classified as horizontal: In order to enable handling at high speeds, the RH-F and RH-FRH series of Robots of the horizontal kind are furnished with 4-axis SCARA (selective compliance assembly robot arm) modules. Inverted four-axis selective compliance assembly robot arm (SCARA) units are used by Mitsubishi’s RH-FHR and RH-FRHR series of ceiling-mounted horizontal robots to expedite work completion without taking up any floor space. Compact SCARA robots: The RH-CH family of four-axis, inexpensive, compact SCARA robots is intended for use in general industrial settings. Micro-working robots: Mitsubishi Electric’s RP series of compact, high-speed robots with a dual-arm design are capable of carrying out a variety of micro-assembly tasks with extreme precision. One of the best automation firms to work for in 2022 is Mitsubishi Electric Corporation, which reported a net profit of 193.1 billion yen in FY 2020. Conclusion These companies are predicted to be among the Top Automation organizations in 2024 due to their developments in automation. These companies employ cutting-edge technologies to make automation simpler.
